mathematical_review.review: The proof reconstructs the d=2 original S, S_T, F, A, h and uniform law. The algebra gives successor states in [1/32,27/32]^2; existing proved V1 state convexity is used explicitly.

The alternating innovation has zero aggregate loading. The squared hinge is constant in innovation and the two quadratic components contribute coefficients 4 and 1, yielding exact p2=5 before any interpolation claim.

A clipped quadratic-tail cut supplies an exactly feasible optimal original-risk density. Holding that density fixed gives G(w)>=G(v)+g(w-v)+(w-v)^2 on the complete feasible interval, including endpoints. Projecting -g/2 supplies a valid lower bound after any finite feasible search.

For every threshold, midpoint Jensen lower bounds and secant endpoint-mixture upper bounds apply to (V1(F)-eta)+. Infima preserve both inequalities. Every cell contributes both endpoints; interior endpoint multiplicity is essential.

Original optimal V1 node bounds give Q bounds. Monotonicity and cash invariance transfer the unchanged uniform V1<=J1<=V1+2^-20 guarantee, adding beta*2^-20 exactly once. No convexity or direct evaluation of the deployed J1 is assumed.

Exact rational sorting and fractional cutoff masses handle atoms. Pointwise intervals sum to fixed-catalogue means. Same exact state/action/risk and identical future controller imply an exact zero policy difference; otherwise interval subtraction is used.

Disjoint enclosures expose an inconsistency for investigation. Intersection alone does not prove fine endpoint coverage. Independent enclosure contained in production would transfer coverage; reverse containment would not. Fixed-action Q lower bounds are not global infimum lower bounds.

The only scientific import is unchanged independent94, with a standard-library import allowlist. Production scientific modules are read for identity custody but are not imported by the validation. Independence is implementation-level primitive reconstruction, not different authorship or a new population sample.

Known post-C catalogue and fixed M=64, 32 terminal steps are disclosed; all 983 keys are frozen without sign selection. No economic evaluation or campaign retiming was part of this review. Exclusive per-policy traces and append/fsync logs preserve failures, and the code performs no automatic retry.
